description: This Java interface defines a SearchQuery for property search operations within the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes methods for creating new instances via a builder, accessing filters, sort and pagination options, and representing the query as a string. It also references external models like SearchFilter, SortOption, LimitOption, and Option.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: An immutable interface representing a property search query, providing access to filters, options, and string representations.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a SearchQuery, requiring a SearchFilter as a parameter.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the main search filter used in the query.

methods.name: getFilterAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the search filter.

methods.name: getSortOption
methods.description: Retrieves the optional sort option for the search results.

methods.name: getAllOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of all options associated with the search query.

methods.name: getOptionsAsString
methods.description: Provides a combined string representation of all options in the query.
